name: staging-cli-run
description: Record the Relay CLI first-run + free→paid fulfilment journey (Mode A + C) as a GIF and grep-able logs, against the isolated staging install. Use when the user mentions recording the CLI first-run, capturing the fulfilment/activation ceremony, a "cli-first-run GIF", Mode A or Mode C capture, the D4 perpetual- fallback proof, minting a staging license, or producing a terminal recording of `relay license add` → `relay pack add`. Also triggers on "staging-cli-run", "record the CLI", "fulfilment GIF", "D4 proof", or any request to capture the license-activation + pack-install ceremony as a reviewable artifact. This RIDES on the `relay-staging` substrate — invoke that skill's `setup` first (the install must exist). Do NOT use for the browser walkthrough (use staging-browser-smoke) or for evaluating a captured bundle (use staging-evaluate).

findings.excerpt: npm run build:cli                      # the CLI the ceremony drives
